title.zh: v2.1.15 手机端重构第一步：五格新外壳与曲风库（/m/home 可访问）
title.en: v2.1.15 Phone Rebuild, Step One: the Five-Module Shell and the Genre Library (/m/home)

highlights.zh: **手机端按新 IA 重建，第一步是外壳 + 曲风库。** 底部五个模块：**首页 · 即兴 · 挑战 · 探索 · 更多**（设置、更新、帮助等杂项归入「更多」）。新的界面是独立的一层（`src/mobile/`），用自己的路由 `/m/<module>` 访问：**现有手机界面照旧工作、照旧被 E2E 覆盖**，新界面一个模块一个模块替换上去；等五个模块都真实可用，再把开关切过去、删掉旧壳。手机上现在就能打开 `/m/home` 试用。
highlights.en: **The phone UI is being rebuilt on the new IA, starting with the shell and the genre library.** Five modules at the bottom: **Home · Jam · Challenge · Explore · More** (settings, updates and help live under More). The new surface is its own layer (`src/mobile/`) on its own route, `/m/<module>`: **the existing phone UI keeps working and keeps being covered by E2E** while the new one replaces it module by module. highlights.zh: **首页就是曲风库**：分类胶囊（六大类，色块与参考稿一致）、搜索（同时匹配英文名与中文别名）、以及每个曲风一行——色块方块兼作试听按钮（走真实引擎的 `useGenreAudition`）、英文名 + 中文名、等宽小字元信息（年代 · BPM · 分类）。点整行**就地展开**该曲风的摘要（听感要点、BPM 区间、拍号、发源地），而不是跳走——参考稿里没有任何从列表看详情的入口，这是净新增的交互。
highlights.en: **Home is the genre library**: category chips (six categories, swatches matching the reference), search (English names and Chinese aliases), and one row per genre — the colour square doubles as the audition button (through the real engine via `useGenreAudition`), then English name plus Chinese name and a monospace meta line (era · BPM · category). Tapping the row **expands that genre's summary in place** (character, BPM range, time signature, origin) instead of navigating aw…

highlights.zh: **规格照手机来**：底部栏每格 ≥56 px、五个模块各带可见文字标签（没有 hover 的设备上，纯图标不可发现）、`aria-current` 标记当前模块；外壳只用自己的设计令牌（深棕 + 琥珀，作用域在 `.mobile-root`，不动桌面），数字一律等宽对齐；横向不溢出、焦点进搜索框不触发 iOS 缩放（输入 16 px）；放大镜与双指缩放由既有的 `user-scalable=no` 拦住。
highlights.en: **Built to phone specs**: every tab is ≥56 px with a visible text label (an icon-only bar is undiscoverable on a device with no hover) and `aria-current` marks the active module; the shell carries its own design tokens (dark brown plus amber, scoped to `.mobile-root`, the desktop untouched) with tabular monospace numerals; no horizontal overflow, and the search field is 16 px so focusing it cannot trigger iOS zoom.
